name: testE18DateTimeCompare
title: E-18 Unit Test: Raw FHIR.dateTime sort / interval compare
description: E-18 unit test library (defect-tracking/engine-issues.md): reproduces the raw FHIR.dateTime 'Values FHIR.dateTime and FHIR.dateTime are not comparable' runtime failure from a define returned/sorted/interval-fed without a FHIRHelpers conversion (CMS156 Index Prescription Start Date), and demonstrates the passing FHIRHelpers.ToDateTime(...) / date from workaround.
